name: jira-delivery
description: Start Jira tickets with a ready-to-build brief, verify your branch against the acceptance criteria before the PR, and hand off — from inside your coding agent.

jira_base_url.title: Jira site URL
jira_base_url.description: Your Jira Cloud site, e.g. https://your-domain.atlassian.net

jira_email.title: Jira account email
jira_email.description: The email of the Atlassian account the API token belongs to

enable_writes.title: Allow write-back to Jira
enable_writes.description: Lets the agent post comments, change status, assign and link. Each write is previewed first and needs a confirmation the agent must get from you. Off by default.
